subject.title: [Feature]: Multi-role support in Chat UI for multi-agent workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable per-message sender identity contract for multi-agent conversations, and which canonical fields and trust rules should flow through Gateway schemas, transcripts, live/history events, and Control UI rendering?
rationale: The remaining work is not a local bug patch; it sets public API, persistence, and UI semantics for human, main-agent, sub-agent, and channel-originated messages.

options.title: Add canonical sender identity
options.body: Introduce an additive sender identity object and migrate projection/UI paths to consume it while keeping current senderLabel compatibility for old transcript rows.

options.title: Keep label-only projection
options.body: Continue using senderLabel/provenance heuristics and close the broad contract request after narrower regressions are fixed.

options.title: Defer to narrower issues
options.body: Leave #38570, #92327, and related targeted reports to improve specific surfaces without committing to a durable cross-surface identity model.

recommendation.title: Add canonical sender identity
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive sender identity object and migrate projection/UI paths to consume it while keeping current senderLabel compatibility for old transcript rows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on inter-session provenance and is the best available owner signal for the cross-surface product/API choice.
